concepts.def: Kinetic, gravitational, elastic, thermal, chemical, etc.
Energy moved between stores mechanically, electrically, by heating or radiation.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transferred.
Useful energy out ÷ total energy in (always less than 100%).
Energy transferred when a force moves an object; W = Fd.
The rate of energy transfer (watts); P = E ÷ t.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A Sankey diagram:

Energy comes in on the left as a thick arrow. Useful energy continues to the right. Wasted energy splits off (often down).

The width of each arrow = the amount of energy.

Conservation: total width in = total width out.

Efficiency = useful energy / total energy.

Express as a decimal or percentage.

LED bulb: 18 J useful out of 20 J in = 18/20 = 0.9 = 90%.

Old bulb: 1 J useful out of 20 J = 5%. Very wasteful!

Better efficiency = less waste = greener and cheaper.

Power = how much energy used per second.

Unit: watts (W). 1 W = 1 J/s.

A kettle is ~2000 W (2 kW). A phone charger is ~10 W.

Higher power = uses more energy per second = bigger bill if left on.

options: kinetic store
gravitational store
chemical store
sound store

mcqs.q: Petrol stores energy in which form?
options: thermal
kinetic
chemical
gravitational

mcqs.q: An object moves in a circle at constant speed. Is it accelerating?
options: Only if it speeds up or slows down on the circle.
Yes — its direction is constantly changing, so its velocity changes; centripetal acceleration points toward the centre of the circle.
No — constant speed means no acceleration.
It is unchanged — only the speed differs.

mcqs.q: Why does Faraday's law include a minus sign (Lenz's law)?
options: The minus sign is a mathematical convention with no physical meaning.
It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
The induced current flows in a direction that opposes the change in flux that produced it — a consequence of energy conservation.
The minus sign means the current flows backwards through the wire.

mcqs.q: If one EM wave has a higher frequency than another, what is true about its wavelength?
options: It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
The minus sign means the current flows backwards through the wire.
It is shorter — wavelength and frequency are inversely related (c = f x lambda).
It is also longer, because both increase together.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Kinetic store”?
options: Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.
Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Energy is conserved”?
options: Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.
Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Energy store”?
options: Energy in food, fuel and batteries; released by reactions.
Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy can't be made or destroyed, only transferred from store to store.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Thermal store”?
options: Where energy is held until transferred — like kinetic, gravitational, chemical, thermal.
Energy in an object held high up; bigger if mass or height is bigger.
Energy in a moving object; faster and heavier objects have more.
Energy in hotter objects; transferred when in contact with cooler ones.
